name: The Broken Town Route

npcs.name: Mayor Cruz
dialogue: The market fire is out, but the town road is blocked by a fresh slope failure. Do not climb across debris.
Use the checked detour and tell the shelter which streets are closed.
after_dialogue: The detour is holding. We can guide families around the slide without entering it.

choice.prompt: The hospital wing is damaged. How should responders proceed?

options.text: Move patients to a checked safe area
options.result: Patients move before staff approach the unsafe wing.
options.consequence: You moved patients to a checked safe area.
options.mascot: Following official warnings and protecting people is the safer choice.

options.text: Restore power inside the damaged wing
options.result: Entering a damaged wing risks further harm.
options.consequence: You sent staff into a damaged wing.
options.mascot: Taking a shortcut through a hazard can injure people and damage resources.

quests.title: Collect the go-bag before the aftershock drill
Search for a flashlight in case aftershocks cut the power.

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety. During shaking: Drop, Cover, Hold On.

quests.community: Find Mayor Cruz and press E.
quests.evacuate: Reach Sturdy Shelter and stay clear of danger.
quests.cover: When shaking starts, get under the sturdy table in the green cover field.

lessons: Stay away from slopes showing cracks, falling debris, or unusual movement.
Move away from a landslide path and use an official safe route.
Do not cross fresh slide debris; more ground may still move.

quiz.question: A landslide blocks the road and the slope still looks unstable. What is safest?
options: Use the official detour and stay clear of the slope
Stand below the slope to watch
quiz.explanation: Avoid landslide paths and fresh debris. Follow the marked route and local responders.

briefing: A slope failure blocks the route through Central Town while the earlier flash fire still threatens the district. Follow the marked detour, help the residents move away from the slope, and reach the evacuation center.
story_clue: The damaged slope exposes cables that match the World Engine signal found at the fire scene.
